subject: Instructor Honorarium — promo credit release for DataSummit workshop
messages:
From: Dr. Ellen Rivera <ellen@datasummit.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19 14:05:12 -0400
Subject: Honorarium options for Aug 12 workshop

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the invite to lead the advanced inference session at DataSummit on Aug 12. Our finance team prefers direct payment, but given the short lead time and my current travel schedule I wondered if Redwood could provide the honorarium as platform credit instead (applied to my speaker account: ellen@datasummit.co).

If acceptable, I can send an invoice and a completed W-9; otherwise we can do a standard wire. Proposed amount is $2,000. Would you be able to issue a promo code or account credit valid for 6 months?

Attached a draft invoice and our W-9 for reference.

Thanks,
Ellen Rivera
Principal Data Scientist, DataSummit
ellen@datasummit.co

Attachments: honorarium_invoice_draft.pdf (pdf), speaker_w9_form.pdf (pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: 2026-07-19 16:30:02 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Honorarium options for Aug 12 workshop — credit instead of wire?

Team,

FYI — Ellen (external, DataSummit) asked whether we can provide the $2k honorarium as Redwood promo credit applied to her account (ellen@datasummit.co) instead of a wire. She attached a draft invoice + W-9.

Ask: can Finance approve issuing a one-time non-refundable promotional credit for $2,000 that:
- is redeemable on hosted API usage only (not transferable)
- expires 6 months from issuance (ideally we can be flexible)
- is tied to her account email (ellen@datasummit.co) and tracked to EVENTS-Q3 GL code

Marcus — can you confirm whether this is fine from a controls/tax perspective and whether we need any additional paperwork? If OK I'll generate a promo code and send Ellen a formal notice with terms; Marissa / Monica tagging you for comms notes.

Thanks,
Tessa
Manager, Events & Community
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20 09:12:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Honorarium options for Aug 12 workshop — credit instead of wire?

Tessa — thanks for the context. Finance is generally fine with issuing platform credits in lieu of cash for honoraria at this size, provided we document the invoice and W-9 and map the cost to the correct GL (EVENTS-Q3). A few notes: 

- We need the signed invoice and W-9 on file before the credit becomes redeemable.
- Credits should be marked as non-refundable and for one-time use on the hosted product (no transfer).
- From a tax perspective, issuing credit vs. cash can have implications for the speaker; ask Ellen if her finance team is okay with receiving value in platform credit — we should capture that confirmation in email.
- If approved, we can create a time-limited promo code via PromoOps. Code generation takes ~1 biz day; please include the HubSpot record id when you request it (HS-REC-87921).

If you can confirm the invoice/W-9 receipt and include the HubSpot id, I'll approve creation and give the GL code.

— Marcus
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Ellen Rivera <ellen@datasummit.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Thanks for sending the draft invoice and W-9 — I've looped in Finance (Marcus) and Events (Marissa / Monica). Marcus approved in principle, pending the signed invoice/W-9 and explicit confirmation from your side that your finance team accepts platform credit in lieu of a wire.

- Amount: $2,000 in Redwood promo credit
- Promo code (provisional): DS-WKSP-ELLEN-0726
- Validity: 6 months from issuance (we can discuss extension if needed)
- Redemption: applies to hosted API usage only; one-time code tied to ellen@datasummit.co

I attached a short notice template and will generate the final promo via PromoOps once we have the signed invoice and W-9. Please confirm and send the signed files when you have a moment.
